ref: #2 §5 Date: DateTrans takes java.text.SimpleDateFormat patterns [SAP✓ https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_NETWEAVER_750/0b9668e854374d8fa3fc8ec327ff3693/4bfbd16f66d33de4e10000000a42189e.html]; ADR-0003; #80: the run's time zone is configurable, and the export takes it as the processor's implicit time zone; assumed reading: a date with an offset keeps its instant and is written in the run's zone (obs-date dateTrans-004)
note: The mapping of fn/dateTrans/003 run at 2026-11-04T13:00:00+01:00, so its zone is +01:00: the same Sku give 2026-11-04 09:00 +0100, 2026-11-04 11:00 +0100, 2026-01-01 00:30 +0100. Writing in UTC would give the output of fn/dateTrans/003.
